policy.name: Goa Industrial Growth and Investment Promotion Policy, 2022 (incentives delivered through the Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017 - 'Umbrella Scheme' and its target schemes)
policy.order_no: Notification No. 3/10/2017-IND/228 (policy, dated 2022-09-30); Umbrella Scheme No. 3/10/2017-IND/268

zones.LDT: Lesser developed talukas: Pernem, Sattari, Bicholim, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona, Dharbandora

zone_lookup: Umbrella Scheme 2017, clause 3(II) Note 2 (Official Gazette Series I No. 28 dated 12-10-2017, p.1424). Zone only changes the cumulative benefit ceiling (50% vs 70% of cumulative capital investment) and hinterland eco-tourism eligibility.

schemes.name: Capital Subsidy Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella target scheme)
schemes.notes: 30% of 'cost of capital' (P&M, ICT equipment needed to run machinery, office/factory premises). Excludes land, pre-operative expenses, office equipment, furniture and ERP. White/green/orange category manufacturing units with commercial production after 1-10-2017, or substantial expansion (>=25% of gross investment). Paid in 2 equal instalments; apply within 1 year of commercial production. Units that took CMRY, other capital subsidy or IT-policy benefits are not eligible. Overall umbrella ceiling across all target schemes is 50% of cumulative capital investment (70% in lesser developed talukas), with +10% for women and SC/ST. The notified validity was to 30-09-2022. A one-year extension to 31-03-2026 is reported (digitalgoa.com, Apr 2025); no extension beyond that was found. The scheme is still listed as open for online application on the official msme.goa.gov.in (UDP) portal.

schemes.name: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella target scheme)

benefit.working_capital: lower of 1.5% of turnover or 30% of interest paid

schemes.notes: 30% OF the interest paid on the term loan (not 30 percentage points). Up to 7 years (27 quarters after the first claim). Requires >=60% Goan employees: benefit scales linearly from 60% at 60% Goan staff to 100% at 80%+. Loans from banks, co-operative banks, EDC or RBI-recognised NBFCs. Same validity caveat as the capital subsidy; currently listed with online application on msme.goa.gov.in. Source PDF: https://api.msme.goa.gov.in//Schemes/DetailsAndDocuments/6d2894ac-81b7-4c2a-9be0-c5d111edb39c.pdf

schemes.name: Financial Incentives for Certification and IPR Reimbursement Scheme, 2017
schemes.clause: Certification & IPR Reimbursement Scheme 2017, para 5.1 (IPR: para 5.2)
schemes.notes: 100% of actual certification charges (excluding travel and lodging), combined ceiling Rs 8 lakh for the whole scheme period. IPR: 50% of professional and registry fees, up to Rs 15 lakh. Source: https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/Financial-Incentives-for-Certification-and-intellectual-property-rights-reimbursement-scheme-2017.pdf . Same validity caveat. Not found on the current UDP portal.

schemes.name: Electricity duty reduction for units installing renewable power (GIGIPP 2022 green practices)
schemes.notes: 100% reduction in electricity duty for units that install renewable power generation and use a fixed % of open rooftop for solar. The policy gives no duration or %, and says 'Detailed notification for the schemes will be issued'. That detailed notification was not found.

other_benefits: Water & energy audit: 25% reimbursement; conservation equipment 25% up to Rs 1,00,000 per unit (GIGIPP 2022 para 13.2(i)(f)(i)-(ii))
Production-linked incentive 2-5% of incremental sales for 5 years 'may' be offered (GIGIPP 2022 para 13.2(i)(a)); no scheme notification found
Other Umbrella target schemes: Incentives to Green Investments, Training Prospective Employees, Encourage Purchases from Local Suppliers, Employment Subsidy (Schedule A of the Umbrella Scheme)
Preferential Purchase Incentives for MSE Scheme 2022 (local procurement)
unverifiable: Validity of the Umbrella Scheme and its target schemes after 31-03-2026: the notified end date was 30-09-2022. An extension to 31-03-2026 is reported only by digitalgoa.com. The Goa gazette site (goaprintingpress.gov.in) returned 403 and ditc.goa.gov.in had an SSL/503 error, so no later extension could be checked. The official UDP portal still lists the Capital and Interest Subsidy schemes as open for online application.
GIGIPP 2022 has no explicit end date; it targets a 5-year horizon (likely to about Oct 2027).
Detailed scheme notifications promised under GIGIPP 2022 (PLI, green incentives) were not found.
A 2026 aggregator (schemesinindia.in) lists a '25% capital subsidy up to Rs 25 lakh' for Goa MSMEs. No official notification was found and it was ignored.
